metadata.scope: Six single batches, three actions at128 policies on each size. Node same-thread host shim runs the production worker module with structuredClone copy/transfer, real canonical journal and fake-indexeddb. No browser Worker scheduling/real postMessage overhead, physical-storage latency or organic-campaign evidence. Setup/import/export/replay excluded from batch timing.

setups.scope: Generated mature fixture plus co-located authored guards to128; permitted exploration unchanged. Policies and route are ordinary recorded commands. Setup times include generation/validation and are separate from batch latency.
